class.name: MaszynaGameDirectory
class.description: The MaSzyna game directory the player chose ([code]maszyna/game_dir[/code] of [UserSettings]) or the one found, and the search for an installation. A different directory is different data: the game's data is read again ([GameDataServer]) and the translations take its [code]lang/[/code] ([method ReloadedTranslationServer.translation_set_catalogue_dir]).

method.name: find_game_dirs
method.description: Returns the game directories found where an installation is usually kept: the executable's directory and the one above it, every game of every Steam library, the folders at the root of each drive and in its [code]Games[/code] folder, and the same in the home directory. Only directories passing [method is_game_dir] are returned, the executable's own first.

method.name: get_game_dir
method.description: Returns the Maszyna game directory in use, as an absolute path. The configured [code]maszyna/game_dir[/code] (resolved against the executable's directory when relative; empty stands for [code]"."[/code]) when it is a game directory (see [method is_game_dir]); otherwise the executable's directory when that one is; otherwise the configured one.

method.name: is_game_dir
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param path] holds the original's data - the [code]scenery[/code], [code]dynamic[/code] and [code]textures[/code] directories.

method.name: is_game_dir_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the directory returned by [method get_game_dir] is a game directory.

method.name: save_game_dir
method.description: Saves the Maszyna game directory path to the config file. This is a shortcut for writing the [code]maszyna/game_dir[/code] setting.
